Hi Diego —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement needs a small package of security/compliance evidence and completed vendor intake before we can start PO routing. Can you please provide the following by EOD Tuesday so our SOW/PO can be drafted?

- SOC 2 Type II report or a one-page attestation (redacted is fine)
- ISO 27001 certificate scan (if available)
- Penetration test attestation or remediation summary from last 12 months
- Completed vendor intake (we'll attach our standard PDF)
- Standard Redwood invoice remit + W9 or equivalent (for finance)

Also confirm: do you accept our standard 45-day net PO terms? If not, who on your team can discuss payment terms?

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any links to where we can pull the artifacts. I attached our vendor intake form for convenience.

Thanks,

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the note and the intake form. We can absolutely get you what you need. Quick summary / plan:

- SOC 2: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and an attestation letter. Full report requires an NDA; happy to sign one.
- ISO 27001: we have a certificate PDF — will attach.
- Pen test: we have a third-party attestation + recent remediation summary; we'll include the pen-test letter (redacted as needed).
- Remit / tax docs: sending our finance contact for W9 and remit details.

On payment terms: our standard is net 30, but we can accept net 45 on annual committed Dedicated contracts. If this is a hosted/usage PO, finance prefers net 30. Can you confirm the contract type?

I attached the artifacts we can share immediately to this thread (redacted where necessary). Marissa from Customer Success is cc'd to coordinate onboarding scheduling. Karthik from Security will add a short note about redaction and approved artifact links.

Next steps I propose:
1) We upload the evidence bundle to a shared Drive link and mark any items that require an NDA.
2) Halcyon returns the completed vendor intake + PO template.
3) Schedule a 30-min procurement kickoff on Thursday to align PO routing and go-live date.

If that works I will book a time — what timezone is best for your team?

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
